newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 470.50/471.75/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 470.50/471.75/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 470.50/471.75 bolivars per dollar Tuesday in quiet trading, as some investors sold dollars for bolivars to participate in CANTV's public share offering, traders said.
"It was a very quiet, very balanced market, with no central bank intervention," said one broker.
Dollars were well supplied by companies and investors, said another, "perhaps they want to buy CANTV shares".
The share offering of Venezuelan telephone company CANTV offering opened Tuesday.
